BiblicalUsage: A cavern is a hole dug out of the rock, and Isaiah uses the word once, of men going into the holes of the rocks and the caves of the earth to hide from the terror of the LORD in the day He arises to shake the earth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the caves are the last hiding place of the proud: when the LORD arises, the rocks will not cover them, and the holes they dug to hide in become their graves.
